Direct Mail Services Across Dutchess County

Cornerstone Services, Inc. (CRST) is a full-service direct mail company serving Dutchess County, NY, offering in-house graphic design, printing, mailing lists, EDDM, and fulfillment since 1998. Based nearby in New Paltz, NY, CRST supports local organizations that want a USPS-certified, no-outsourcing partner for direct mail campaigns across Dutchess County.

Major Dutchess County Service Areas

Direct Mail in Poughkeepsie

Pop. 32,700 • ZIP: 12601, 12602, 12603, 12604

Poughkeepsie is the county seat of Dutchess County and one of the largest cities in the Hudson Valley. Home to Vassar College, Marist College, and a revitalized waterfront district, Poughkeepsie offers diverse neighborhoods and a strong commercial base. Our New Paltz facility is just 20 minutes across the Mid-Hudson Bridge, giving Poughkeepsie businesses fast, convenient access to full-service direct mail.

Beacon

Beacon has transformed from a quiet river town into one of the Hudson Valley's most vibrant communities. Anchored by Dia:Beacon, Main Street's gallery and restaurant scene, and excellent Metro-North access, Beacon attracts young professionals, artists, and families. Direct mail helps local businesses stand out in this competitive, fast-growing market.
